Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Suncrest home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Suncrest with a median price of $1,550,000 (the middle half sold between $1,415,000 and $1,590,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $640 per square foot, a median year built of 1956 and a median lot of 7,020 square feet. 4 duplexes sold in Suncrest, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Suncrest?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 houses listed in Suncrest. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Suncrest a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Suncrest from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Suncrest over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Suncrest compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In October 2026, Suncrest held 0.7% of the 430 detached houses listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Suncrest than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 4 in June to 3 in October 2026 (−25.0%).

faq.q: What did houses in Suncrest sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Suncrest between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,550,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Suncrest?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
